# Public Site CMS Contract

The public GitHub Pages frontend is a presentation layer over canonical repository truth.

## Edit these sources

- `../VERSION`
- `../wiki/Home.md`
- `../students/david/progress.md`
- `../knowledge-base/executor-benchmark-framework.md`
- `index.template.html` only for public layout/navigation design
- `cms.js` only for rendering behaviour

## Do not edit as truth

- `public-state.json` — generated by `../scripts/build_public_state.py`
- `../index.html` — generated from `index.template.html`

## Flow

```text
canonical sources
→ Generate Public Site State Action
→ public-state.json + index.html
→ Pages
```

The browser loads `public-state.json` from `main`, so current learner/benchmark facts are not independently maintained in HTML.
